conservative.read: This conservative plan targets capital preservation with an expected ~1.5%/month return. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower drawdowns but also more modest growth potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan prioritizes risk-first growth, targeting ~2.5%/month. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate growth with controlled risk.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month by stretching growth and using leverage. It increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month by rotating into income and broad index ETFs for steady distributions. It cuts leverage and high-beta names to near zero, prioritizing low drawdown. Remember, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
